chunks.subject: AP Physics C: Mechanics
chunks.title: Q1 Mathematical Routines (MR) — 10 points
chunks.content: AP Physics C: Mechanics FRQ 1 is Mathematical Routines (MR), 10 points, scored by lettered sub-points. The MR task requires multi-step (often calculus-based) derivations/calculations with correct physics relationships, substitutions, and consistent expressions. Q1 topic: momentum and a collision between blocks/objects (conservation of momentum, impulse, energy). Points reward the governing relationship (conservation of momentum, impulse–momentum, energy), correct substitutions, and final expressions consistent with earlier parts. Common failure: omitting the conservation equation; energy/momentum confusion; expressions inconsistent with prior parts.
